description:
Brand introduction

Tack is a tech-forward brand focused on creating reliable, innovative solutions to help people protect and track what matters most. Whether it's keeping tabs on pets, loved ones, or important belongings, Tack GPS provides peace of mind with real-time tracking you can count on.


Product description

Tack GPS is a smart, compact, and durable GPS tracker designed for various use cases—keeping an eye on elderly family members, tracking pets, securing valuables, and more. With ultra long battery life, precision tracking, and an easy-to-use mobile app called OurSphere, Tack GPS ensures you a peace of mind that you can always stay connected to the people and things that matter. 


USP (Unique Selling Point)

Ultra-Long Battery Life: Unlike any other GPS Trackers, Tack GPS can last up to 30 days of tracking on a single charge, minimizing the need for frequent recharging. 

Global Coverage: Tack GPS Plus* operates in over 120 countries, offering seamless tracking across borders without additional roaming charges. 

Fall Detection: Tack GPS Plus* is equipped with sensors that detect sudden impacts or falls. In the event of a fall, the device can automatically send an alert to designated contacts, ensuring prompt assistance. ​

Indoor Elevation Finder™: Tack GPS Plus* devices are equipped with advanced sensors capable of determining elevation changes indoors. This feature enhances location accuracy within multi-level buildings, enabling precise tracking even when GPS signals are limited. ​

Compact and Lightweight Design: The device is small and discreet, making it ideal for tracking children, pets, and valuable assets without adding bulk.

Weatherproof Construction: Built to withstand various weather conditions, ensuring reliable performance in both indoor and outdoor environments.

Advanced Tracking Technology: Utilizes a combination of GPS and Wi-Fi Positioning System (WPS) for accurate location tracking, even indoors.

Location History: Tack GPS provides a comprehensive log of all recorded locations up to 14 days, allowing users to review the device's movement over time. This feature is particularly useful for monitoring travel patterns, ensuring the safety of loved ones, or tracking asset movements.

Safe Zone Alerts: Allows users to set up geofences and receive notifications when the device enters or leaves designated areas, providing peace of mind for caregivers and pet owners.

Emergency Mode: In case of an emergency, the device can report its location every two minutes for up to an hour, facilitating quick assistance.

User-Friendly Mobile App: The OurSphere app, available for both iOS and Android, enables easy monitoring, real-time notifications, device management, as well as phone to phone location sharing.
